stories.title: RBI warns of inflation risks from West Asia conflict and El Nino despite resilient economy
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India highlighted that ongoing conflict in West Asia and the expected El Nino weather pattern could push inflation higher, even as it noted the Indian economy remains resilient. The central bank’s commentary flagged these external factors as potential risks to price stability.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
stories.previousTitle: RBI flags inflation risks from West Asia conflict and El Nino despite resilient economy
stories.previousSummary: The Reserve Bank of India said inflation pressures could rise because of the war in West Asia and an expected El Nino weather pattern, even though the Indian economy remains resilient. stories.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
stories.summary: US First Lady Melania Trump has "successfully secured" a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, the White House has said. It said the truce in the "front-line war city on the brink of disaster" without medicine, food and clean water would begin on 29 October.

stories.title: Gun attack in Paris suburbs labeled racist terrorist attack by Macron
stories.summary: A shooter opened fire from his car in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and nearby La Verrière, killing one person and wounding five others. French President Emmanuel Macron described the incident as a “racist terrorist attack” and said it was the first random racial killing in the Republic. The attacker was arrested and prosecutors said the case appears to be murder linked to a terrorist enterprise.
stories.why: It underscores concerns about racially motivated terrorism in France and may influence security policy.
stories.previousTitle: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
stories.previousSummary: French President Emmanuel Macron has labelled a gun attack in a Parisian suburb that killed one person and injured five others "a racist terrorist attack". The attack unfolded over some 15 minutes, with the attacker opening fire from his car - first in Trappes, to the south-west of Paris, and then in nearby La Verrière - appearing to target people of migrant origin.
